title: DOW-UAP-PR109, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2015
what_is_it: A declassified US military infrared video clip of an unresolved Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon (UAP), released with a written description.
interpretation_warnings: The video was digitally altered before it reached investigators, so it does not represent unmodified original sensor data.
No formal data-handling practices existed at the time of reporting, weakening the provenance and chain of custody.
The government description explicitly states it is informational only and not an analytical judgement or investigative finding.
The object is described only as 'an area of contrast'; no identification, size, distance, or speed is established.
The 2015 date and infrared-sensor origin are qualified as 'likely', not confirmed.
